## AI Game Library — weekly newsletter
1. Make a Google Sheet with a tab named **Games** (columns: name, url, discussion, source, engagement, comments, viralScore, foundOn, status). Import games/top100.csv into it to seed the library.
2. Paste the sheet URL into both Google Sheets nodes and connect your Google account.
3. Connect Gmail and set recipients (or swap the last node for Beehiiv / Buttondown / Telegram / Discord).
4. Run once manually, then turn the workflow **Active**.
